findings.evidence: ChevalleyRelations.lean:8 is the file's sole import. In-repo precedent: the matrix-level analogue Transvection.lean (271 lines) keeps `transvectionUnit`, `commute_transvectionUnit` (:204), `commutatorElement_transvectionUnit` (:221), the torus-conjugation relation and naturality in one file. RootSubgroup.lean's module doc already states these relations 'hold at the level of the matrices … and the points equivalences `pointsMulEquiv` and `gaPointsMulEquiv` transport them to any of the three views', so a reader looks for them there; the PR also leaves that docstring unupdated.
findings.fix: Move `commute_rootSubgroupPoints` and `commutatorElement_rootSubgroupPoints` into RootSubgroup.lean (a `section Relations` after `section Points`), fold the relevant module-doc paragraph and the Carter/Humphreys references into that file's header, and delete ChevalleyRelations.lean. No new imports are needed: RootSubgroup.lean already has `public import TauCeti.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.Transvection` (line 14) and `AdditiveGroup.Scheme`, which imports `AdditiveGroup.Basic` (Scheme.lean:9), the home of `gaPointMul`.
findings.issue: The whole file is a 101-line satellite whose only import is its parent RootSubgroup.lean (314 lines), and whose two theorems elaborate `rootSubgroupPoints` defined there. It splits the root-subgroup API across two modules with no dependency reason.

summary: The two new theorems belong in TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/GeneralLinear/RootSubgroup.lean, which defines rootSubgroupPoints and already supplies every dependency; the new module adds nothing but a file boundary. gaPointMul's placement and all imports are fine.
